title: Agnus Dei
subtitle: A qualified model should be cold, slick, and unmoving, like a block of ice.

items.text: They said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens."

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: These murals have nearly faded away.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Nonetheless, it appears we can rule out a biblical scene, nor does it appear to connect with any significant Greco-Roman mythology.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Perhaps there's some metaphor hidden in the narrative of these paintings? And if we can figure it out, we will find our way to the secret chamber.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The problem is ... there are so many murals; where do we begin?

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: In most cases, you view a fresco straight ahead and from top to bottom.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm ... in this order, they seem to be telling a simple story about a group of people ... and a peculiar bird.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Simple and straightforward, except for this part.
Ezio gazes at the blank area at the center of the fresco.
As if by silent agreement, the faded pigments around it all keep their distance.
All the questions seem to center there.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: What is the meaning of this ...?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What is the meaning of this ...?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: M-My face! Why have you made it look so horrible ...?

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Please don't worry, miss; this is only the first stage of my draft.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: I must draw out the details in rough so that you won't end up looking like an empty shell.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: They will help to express how you stand, move around, and exhibit feelings.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: R-Really? Then Miss Sotheby will still look pretty, right? Once you've finished with all the glamorous colors and those adorable little angels ...

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: In a sort of way, yes. Except, of course, that it won't be you; it will be the Virgin Mary.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: But other than that, you'll have everything you hope for, including all the colors and the little angels!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hooray!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I hadn't actually thought you'd use the time to paint.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Of course! And we must take our work seriously at that—Father Alberto may show up for an inspection at any time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm, I noticed you've used some guidelines in the background. Are you using linear perspective theory?
The painter's eyes light up with surprise and delight.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Gosh! I hadn't expected you to know about that!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where we come from, mastering this fundamental concept is essential for every artist.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: A fundamental? That would make your homeland some kind of painter's paradise? Don't tell me even your snails can paint!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh, that would be such a delight, don't you think?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I've never painted snails, but I've painted eggs! Mr. Karson once told me it was a part of your training method that—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Excuse me ... Sorry to interrupt.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Perhaps, Mr. Leonardo you could tell us more about your use of linear perspective? My understanding of it might differ from yours.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: With pleasure!
